description: Geo-level Meridian MMM: straight-line baseline (knots = 2, one knot at each end), media effects strongly pooled across geos (eta_m ~ HalfNormal(0.1)), geometric adstock with max lag 4, ROI priors LogNormal(0.2, 0.9) on all paid channels.
units: revenue (conversions x revenue_per_conversion); ROI = revenue per unit spend
credible_interval: 94% (3rd-97th percentile of 4 chains x 1000 posterior draws)

columns.contribution_mean/_ci_lo/_ci_hi: Incremental revenue attributed to the channel (vs zero spend): posterior mean and 94% CI.
columns.roi_mean/_ci_lo/_ci_hi: Incremental revenue / spend: posterior mean and 94% CI.
columns.mroi_mean/_ci_lo/_ci_hi: Marginal ROI: incremental revenue from a 1% spend increase / that extra spend.
columns.spend: Total channel spend over the period.
columns.share_of_revenue: Posterior mean contribution / total observed revenue.
columns.prior_driven: True if the data barely narrowed the ROI (contraction below the gate minimum).
columns.payback_determined: True if P(ROI > 1) is at least 0.9 or at most 0.1.

notes: Cost per incremental KPI is not reported: the modelled outcome is converted to revenue.
